response.sql: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_record_count FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat, AVG(r.site_ratio) AS average_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(r.site_ratio - a.status_avg_ratio) AS average_excess FROM site_ratios AS r JOIN status_averages AS a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.site_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A zero geometric accuracy makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is ignored; the mesh record still counts toward the site's mesh record count.
